verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: Weekend problem rate is 2.2x the weekday rate; weekend service changes / planned work likely.
MTA reports 'Planned ROW Work' as 27% of delays on line(s) L (1.2x the system share) in the analysed months.
16% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'reduced_service' alert was active for the line (problem rate 18% with an alert vs 9% without, lift 2.0x).
7% of problem arrivals happened while an MTA 'rolling_stock' alert was active for the line (problem rate 18% with an alert vs 9% without, lift 2.0x).
MTA reports 'Infrastructure & Equipment' as 40% of delays on line(s) L (1.1x the system share) in the analysed months.
MTA reports 'Police & Medical' as 19% of delays on line(s) L (0.9x the system share) in the analysed months.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on L during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Review car-class reliability for L; pull chronic door/brake defects from peak assignments
recommendations.rationale: Mechanical alerts correlate with problem arrivals.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer disabled trains blocking the line.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for L; use alternates other lines at the station
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for L; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Stage a spare train set near 8 Av during the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: A ready spare turns a 20-minute gap into a 5-minute one.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the size of mechanical-caused gaps.

recommendations.action: Prioritise infrastructure & equipment work orders on the L corridor near 8 Av
recommendations.rationale: Infrastructure categories over-index in MTA-reported delays for the line.

sources_used: NY Open Data: trains delayed / incidents
caveats: scheduled counts scaled by observed coverage (1385 polling intervals); hours covered < 50% excluded from service delivered
no hour of the day worsened significantly versus the baseline; results describe the whole day
